habit.description: After blocking a projectile the Oni dashes straight in. Throw a second projectile or meet the dash with a throw or anti-air before it arrives.

notes: Oni patient (Y2): walks in, punishes whiffs. The whiff punish is a dash_forward stand-in for the Iron-Club Charge. PROVISIONAL: data/moves/ has no Oni normals or Iron-Club Charge yet (clips blocked on concept art), so this uses only generic actions (walk, dash, jump, block, throw) and cannot strike at close range. When oni-* normals and special:iron-club-charge land, add close-range pokes and swap the whiff punish to the charge. No ids invented.
